The node weighs credit received over votes cast: an attestation counts only when the receiver never attested the giver, and a pair trading both ways cancels, so a closed ring adds nothing. Fifty clones aiming at each other end flat, arrows meeting their mirror on return. Weight needs outside credit, fifty established identities that never get attested back, each posting a 500 POA bond for 30 days, 25,000 POA in wallets he does not own.

An honest peer ends an epoch with a dozen arrows from readers who never repaid. A ripple travels out; a walled oasis holds water that never moves.
